pool.text: NBCC founded a small settlement in the area known as Gaya Bay.
A local rebel leader named Mat Salleh destroyed the place by fire.
NBCC decided to relocate the settlement to the mainland at Gantian Bay.
Henry Walker identified a site opposite Gaya Island as a suitable settlement place.
Mary Edith Atkinson built the Atkinson Clock Tower near Bandaran Berjaya.
Japanese forces quelled the rebellion after Albert Kwok was arrested and executed.
The town suffered further devastation when Allied forces bombed it.
The British Crown declared Jesselton as the new capital of North Borneo.
Jesselton was renamed as Kota Kinabalu after Mount and the Malay word.
Hospital Mesra Bukit Padang opened to provide psychiatric services for the state.
Ministers died in a plane crash known as the Double Six Tragedy.
Kota Kinabalu town board was upgraded to municipal status by authorities.
Wetlands were conserved by the State Government to foster understanding and awareness.
Kota Kinabalu was officially granted city status by the administration.
Kota Kinabalu Port handled about 3.6 million tonnes of freight cargo.
Iliyas took over the post to become the second mayor of the city.
Queen Elizabeth Hospital II was established after acquiring the former building.
The Tanjung Aru railway station was moved to Aeropod with facilities.
The KK City WiFi was announced for public and tourist use.
Russia set up their branch office of RCSC to expand co-operation.
